blocks.content: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) is a specialized statutory tribunal established to ensure effective and expeditious disposal of cases relating to environmental protection, conservation of forests, and natural resources. It provides compensation for damages caused to people and property and plays a major role in promoting sustainable development in India.

The National Green Tribunal (NGT) is a specialized statutory tribunal established to ensure effective and expeditious disposal of cases relating to environmental protection, conservation of forests, and natural resources.

items: NGT is a statutory body created specifically for environment-related litigation.
It handles matters concerning environmental protection, forest conservation, and natural resources.
It has the authority to award compensation for environmental damages to individuals and property.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) is a specialized statutory tribunal in India.
Its primary purpose is ensuring effective and expeditious disposal of environmental, forest conservation, and natural resource cases.
The tribunal is empowered to provide compensation for damages caused to people and property.
NGT plays a crucial role in advancing sustainable development across the country.
